from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document record with its title and applicable case categories."""
    title: str = Field(description="The exact title of the judgment document as it appears in the source text (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    categories: list[Literal['执行案件', '民事案件', '管辖案件', '刑事案件', '赔偿案件', '行政案件']] = Field(description="The subset of the 6 task-defined case categories that apply to this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
